primary_analysis: Confirmatory: compute paired_success_rate_difference_guarded_minus_baseline on K=200 paired tasks (records with pair_inclusion_flag included_in_primary_analysis = true) using a paired‑proportion (McNemar/equivalent) test plus bootstrap (10,000 resamples) to produce a 95% CI. Implementation uses the preregistered paired_binary_analysis_v1 executor, CPU run, preregistered seeds and the execution artifacts in execution/*.jsonl and execution/scoring/*.json.
secondary_analyses: absolute_apply_success_rate_guarded_minus_baseline: per‑arm apply success rates and absolute difference (descriptive; Holm adjustment for reported p‑values across these secondary estimands).
median_time_to_deploy_difference_seconds: Kaplan–Meier style time‑to‑successful‑apply estimation per arm with log‑rank test (right‑censor at max iterations) and reported median difference.

mean_model_calls_per_successful_apply_difference: per‑arm mean model_calls_used per successful apply and difference (reported with standard errors); subgroup descriptive tables by preregistered vendor/feature clusters with Holm correction.
sensitivity_analyses: complete_pair_primary_with_failure_as_zero_sensitivity (treat any missing/failed arm as regression failure) — exact preregistered alternate failed‑call treatment
bootstrap_resamples_5k_and_20k: recompute primary bootstrap CI with 5,000 and 20,000 resamples to check CI stability (uses same seeds/artifacts)

flagged_items_as_failures: include items automatically flagged by contamination detection (duplicate intent hashes or stateful headers) and treat them as failures to show robustness of primary estimand
subgroup_smallN_robustness: repeat paired analysis excluding subgroups with < preregistered minimum counts and report as exploratory
uncertainty_quantification: Primary uncertainty via nonparametric bootstrap (10,000 resamples) producing 95% percentile CIs (bootstrap seed recorded in execution logs). Sensitivity CIs recalculated at 5k and 20k resamples. Standard errors reported for secondary mean estimands; Kaplan–Meier confidence bands per standard Greenwood formula. All uncertainty computations executed by paired_binary_analysis_v1 using artifacts in execution/scoring/*.json and execution/raw_results.jsonl.
multiplicity_implementation: Single preregistered confirmatory test (H1) at alpha=0.05. All secondary and subgroup comparisons labeled exploratory; reported p‑values for secondary/familywise comparisons adjusted using the Holm method as preregistered.
contamination_analysis: Detection and treatment per preregistration: deterministic SHA‑256 hashing of intent/prompts and per‑call response/provider header logging (artifacts under execution/provider_calls/ and execution/responses/). Duplicates or matching response hashes are automatically flagged and excluded from the primary analysis (exclusion_reason stored in per‑task records). Flagged items are reported in the exclusions/missingness manifest; sensitivity analyses include flagged items treated as failures. Reserved verification subset and per‑call header hashes are stored for residual nondetectable training‑overlap/statefulness assessment (artifacts referenced in execution/).
table_specifications: Table 1 — Primary paired contingency: counts (both no regression, only guarded no regression, only baseline no regression, both regression), paired_success_rate_difference_guarded_minus_baseline, primary test statistic, and 95% bootstrap CI (from execution/aggregates).

Table 2 — Secondary estimands: per‑arm apply success rates, absolute difference, Holm‑adjusted p‑values; median time_to_deploy_seconds per arm and difference; mean model_calls_per_successful_apply per arm and SE.
Table 3 — Subgroup breakdown: vendor/feature cluster counts, paired differences and descriptive CI (preregistered clusters from task_manifest), with Holm adjustment applied within reported families.
Table 4 — Exclusions & missingness manifest: list of excluded tasks with intent_hash, exclusion_reason, and counts (derived from execution/raw_results.jsonl and per‑task scoring JSONs).
Table 5 — Execution summary: planned vs completed episodes, model_calls_used, elapsed wallclock, artifact hashes manifest (from execution_manifest).
figure_specifications: Figure 1 — Bar plot of regression‑causing change rate by condition (baseline vs guarded) with 95% bootstrap CIs (data from execution/scoring/*.json).
Figure 2 — Kaplan–Meier curves for time‑to‑successful‑apply per condition with 95% confidence bands and log‑rank p‑value (uses time_to_deploy_seconds and apply_attempted fields from paired records).
Figure 3 — Distribution of model_calls_used per successful apply (histogram / violin) and cumulative model calls vs successful applies curve (cost/benefit visualization).
Figure 4 — Heatmap or table visualization of residual regressions by vendor/feature cluster (to show concentration of failures); data from per‑task scoring JSONs and preregistered cluster mapping.
